proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ G X Y hG hX hY
  refine ⟨fun h => MeasureTheory.condExp_mono hX hY h, ?_⟩
  have h1 : (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (X)) ≤ᵐ[P] (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (fun ω => |X ω|)) := MeasureTheory.condExp_mono hX hX.abs (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => le_abs_self _)
  have h2 : (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (-X)) ≤ᵐ[P] (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (fun ω => |X ω|)) := MeasureTheory.condExp_mono hX.neg hX.abs (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => neg_le_abs _)
  filter_upwards [h1, h2, MeasureTheory.condExp_neg X G] with ω w1 w2 w3
  rw [w3] at w2
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by simpa using neg_le.mp w2, w1⟩
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (G : MeasurableSpace Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ), G ≤ m0 → MeasureTheory.Integrable X P → MeasureTheory.Integrable Y P → (X ≤ᵐ[P] Y → (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (X)) ≤ᵐ[P] (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (Y))) ∧ (fun ω => |(MeasureTheory.condExp G P X) ω|) ≤ᵐ[P] (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (fun ω => |X ω|))
